C1426.title: Bitcoin Gold Hit by Another 51% Attack, Losing $70,000
C1426.summary: In January 2020, Bitcoin Gold suffered another 51% attack, exploiting the same vulnerability as the 2018 incident. The attacker double-spent $70,000 worth of BTG, further tarnishing the network's reputation and highlighting the persistent risk of blockchains relying on limited hashing power.

references.title: Over $70,000 Double Spent As Bitcoin Gold Experiences Its Second 51% Attack
